issues.title: Seller says clogged catalyst on 2008 B235 9-5 wagon without confirmed restriction or upstream engine health
issues.cause: Catalyst may be internally damaged by severe misfire/unburned fuel or suffer flow restriction downstream; a weak engine can also have fuel, intake, ignition and turbo issues. Historic non-US bulletin is not US-market test authorization.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Capture seller chronology, original scanned DTCs freeze frames, actual engine ability to turn and any overheating/oil-pressure/misfire history; obtain independent in-scope professional converter backpressure/location assessment plus intake/ignition/fuel tests only if safe. Never equate P0420 with a blocked converter.
issues.correction_summary: No replacement plan until correct exhaust assembly, restriction and its initiating cause are confirmed, plus structural/underbody safety and total cost evaluated. Treat unknown as no-buy-budget risk if a rebuild or transmission replacement would be unaffordable.
limits: Bulletin 248-2506 is from Nov 2004, explicitly not US/CA, and its Tech2 test requires a RUNNING car; source directory /2008/ does not override market.
Exhaust hardware diagram is MY2007; specific MY2008 VIN and US emissions components not manufacturer-approved.
Do not price or diagnose a converter solely from a seller claim; no observed real vehicle data.

issues.title: Original 9-5 no-start or weak-power cannot be distinguished from internal damage by DTC absence
issues.cause: T7 WIS identifies ignition cassette main relay/ground and crank/cam synchronization and fuel flow/air leaks as possible diagnostic branches, including faults without stored DTC.
symptoms: engine cranks but does not start
low power with no check engine
issues.diagnosis_summary: Only collect seller history, safe battery/engine exterior checks and read-only DTC evidence until qualified mechanical condition is established; then inspect power/ground, ignition, fuel, intake as permitted. A working starter does not prove normal oil pressure or compression.
issues.correction_summary: Fix only confirmed external control or flow fault and assess engine condition before assuming cheap non-running repair. Do not substitute red Trionic T7 ignition cassette or bypass software/programming requirements.
limits: No accessible test on a non-running car certifies internal engine bearings.
Fuel pressure circuits and high-voltage ignition require specialist safety precautions.

issues.title: 2006 9-3 B207 low compression is a measured mechanical red flag, not a trim or warm idle guess
issues.cause: Factory lists 12.4 bar minimum but requires proper isolated ignition/fuel and controlled cranking per-cylinder conditions; low readings need leakdown or internal condition evaluation.
symptoms: crank/no-start with one or more low cylinder readings
seller claims engine turns so engine is healthy
issues.diagnosis_summary: Do not crank a hydrolocked, overheated, oil-starved or visibly damaged engine. For safe eligible vehicle use factory compression test with recorded conditions and instrument/technician; pursue leakdown, coolant/valve/timing differential as required.
issues.correction_summary: If compression/leakdown proves valve or lower-end mechanical work, price that as major internal engine risk, not a routine ignition fix.
limits: 12.4 bar is engine and MY2006 specific.
Existing intake valve campaign evidence applies to different source years/engines; do not generalize to every 2005/06 B207.
No actual compression values or car mechanical clearance observed.

issues.title: 5AT slipping/contaminated gearbox and low engine oil pressure are hard purchase-screen blockers without tests
issues.cause: External transmission solenoid/sensor faults can mimic a failed gearbox; low true hot engine oil pressure can indicate oil-system damage, which oil warning lamp alone cannot screen. Distinct year-specific FA57 DTC branches already stored in prior datasets.
symptoms: seller says bad automatic / won't move
red oil-pressure lamp, hot knock or severe overheating history
no ATF sample or temperature-controlled TCM results
issues.diagnosis_summary: Use existing year-specific FA57 DTC and ATF level/condition records, oil pressure specification only under validated hot test conditions, actual VIN/transmission identity and professional condition tests; unknown transmission internals and bearings remain unknown.
issues.correction_summary: If internal ratio slip, clutch contamination, bearing wear or low controlled oil pressure is confirmed, set rebuild/replace-risk classification and require full qualified quote; no assumption of easy solenoid or cooler repair.
limits: References earlier FA57 diagnostics and 2005/09 adaptation in existing datasets; source IDs here only establish 2009 engine oil pressure and ECU evidence.
Does not extend 2003–05 NG9-3 FA57 coolant campaign to 9-5.
No road-test, full-throttle stall test or hot idling until engine safety confirmed.
